newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends lower despite late covering.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends lower despite late covering.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Sept (3rd pos) 1,126 rgt/tonne July (south) 1,165
Open/Hi/Low 1,135/1,135/1,121 Prev close 1,180
Prev settlement 1,137 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended generally lower despite some late covering influenced by demand in some products. Speculation over July 1-10 export data had no impact. Technical selling emerged after Sept futures hit 1,130. Next support seen at 1,110 before hitting 1,100.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Followed the futures and the market reported some business among RBD palm olein for Aug/Sept.
"Technically, the market still looks weak and the charts are still pointing downwards," a technical analyst said.
Technical selling also emerged after September futures broke the 1,130 ringit level and then fell to a low of 1,121.
At the close, the contract was 11 ringgit lower at 1,126 ringgit ($452.12) a tonne.
"The contract will try to test 1,110 before falling to the psychological level of 1,100 level," said the analyst.
Traders said rising output and expectations of higher stocks also eased market sentiment.
Speculation over export data in the first 10 days of July also had no impact, said traders.
Turnover was 1,807 lots.
Physicals saw July (south) crude palm oil saw offers at 1,165 ringgit against bids at 1,160 after trading at 1,160.
July (central) saw offers at 1,155 ringgit versus 1,147.50.
Aug (south) was offered at 1,165 against bids of 1,160, and Aug (central) at 1,165 against bids of 1,160.
In refined products, July RBD palm oil was offered at $495 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Aug at $492.50, Sept at $490 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $490.
July RBD palm olein saw offers at $530, Aug/Sept at $537.50, and Oct/Nov/Dec at $525. First 20 days of July was traded at $527.50, Aug at $525 and $523 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $522.50.
July RBD palm stearin was offered at $375 and July/Aug/Sept palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290.
